sentence: The venture-funding payoff runs through a U-shape with its turning point near USD 11.3 million
passage: [Banna & Alam (2025), sec. 4.1] "the turning point is observed at a log AI investment value of approximately 2.425 [ ] corresponding to approximately USD 11.3 million in AI-related venture funding."
